title: Examen de nivel A1
supersedes: build/EXAM-a1-assembly-rulings.md R1-R9 (2026-11-11) + build/EXAM-a1-u01-draft-and-pool-spec.md §1 (a1-u01 items) + LEAD RULINGS R-1…R-6
authority: Palabra learner records are authoritative. Eldoria flags mirror exam state; they never source it.

binding.rule: Every item binds its word by `es`, byte-identical, to a bound id in the shared taught pool (rebase-pool.py: 416 ids after a1-u08). No slugs, no integer indices, no lowercasing, no trimming, no accent-stripping. Item key = `<es>#<formSeed>`.
binding.formSeed: block offset per unit (u01 101-113 as authored, uNN <unitNumber><authoredIndex>): seeds the deterministic option-order shuffle per attempt so a retake is a new form under the same item key, and the key never collides when two units share an `es`.
binding.sourcePacks: a1-u01…a1-u08 examContribution (items copied verbatim; verse blocks byte-identical to their pack scripture) + a1-u08-verse-lke-5-5.json (the R-2 companion verse pack).

voice.note: uniform exam conditions (exam-a0 ruling 4 precedent); the scripture voice returns in lessons, not here
voice.replay: each item's audio replays on tap, unlimited, no penalty
voice.verseFirst: every verse-complete item plays the FULL verse and shows it before the gap is asked — never a blind quiz (owner quality bar 2026-11-11)

scoring.channels: floors are counted by PATTERN SLOT, not by render mode: 7 of the 8 hear-act slots currently render through their hear-choose twin (no prop sprite, R6) but still count in the hear-act channel. Never ship a dead slot; never let missing art move a floor.
scoring.rescaleNote: 80% of 50 = 40. Floors: hear-choose 20/24 (~83%), hear-act 6/8 (75%), gap-fill 6/8 (75%), verse 6/7 (~86%). Pass needs the total AND every floor. speak 0 in v1 — no scorer exists, so no dead slot (R1).

onPass.xpRule: first pass only, gated on flag-not-set
onPass.explain: rewards are explained in Spanish at the pass moment (owner quality bar)

onFail.retake: locked until every word missed here is cleared in a non-exam frame

audioFail: exam pauses; it never silently degrades to a text-only screen
rendererContract: hear-choose = 3 text options; hear-act = 3 sprite options keyed by `es` (art looked up by the word itself, no second id space) — items carrying renderFallback render as their hear-choose twin until the prop sprite lands; verse-complete = 4 text options with the full verse heard and read first; gap-fill = sentence with one blank + 3 text choices; reading-item = passage + question + 3 text choices. Listening items carry NO prompt caption — prompt is audio only, so the answer is never printed. gap-fill and reading-item contracts do not exist yet in the frame engine (R7): those 11 slots are authored and validated here but cannot ship until the contracts refactor lands.
sampling: exam-a1 samples ~40% of the A1 new-id set by design (50 items across 8 units, 416 taught ids); the miss→recordMiss→replay loop closes the rest. A unit's pack may contribute 13 authored items while the exam samples 5-7 — this is sampling, not a coverage defect (R8). Reserve items stay in their packs and are legal alternates; swapping one never changes the pattern slot.

verseLedger.dropped: u04 pro-31-24 and u07 1sa-16-7 — both still ship inside their unit lessons, they are simply not exam-tested (R-3). If U8 had filed with only one verse binding, lke-5-5's slot would have stayed empty rather than being backfilled by a dropped OT verse.
verseLedger.gospelQuota: E3 CLOSES at 7 of ≥7 Gospel verses taught (Mt 7:13, Mt 7:14, Lk 2:1-7, Mrk 1:41, Lk 15:24, Mt 4:21, Lk 5:5); the exam samples 6 of them (Mt 7:14 is the a0 revisit, not an A1 binding).
verseLedger.revisits: psa-119-105 is served by a1-u02 with es=lámpara (never re-target; exam-a0 served it with es=camino — revisit recorded). mat-7-13 is served here with es=perdición; exam-a0 served the same passage at mat-7-14 with es=puerta — revisit 1 of max 2 per band.
verseLedger.byteIdentity: every verse/verseModern/missing/missingModern/captionSplit block is copied byte-identically from its pack (R5); captionSplit ships 1909 orthography (u05/u06/u07 convention) and the modern line is served via verseModern/missingModern — the owner's RV pick decides which renders.

renderDebt.hearActSprites: 8 hear-act pattern slots; only puerta has a confirmed prop sprite (exam-a0's set: puerta, casa, camino, moneda, pan, cesta). 7 slots carry renderFallback=hear-choose (ventana, puente, zapato, cabeza, corazón, escudo, nariz).
renderDebt.artOwed: ventana, lámpara, puente, pesebre, zapato, sombrero, cabeza, mano, corazón, familia, escudo, piedra, nariz, diente, medicina, red, barco + the toca/señala action icons (DEFECTS #17).
renderDebt.tileDebt: SHORT tiles (vas 3, red 3) need min-width; LONG reflexive tiles (se levantan 14) need wrap/scale; the -ó/-ió ending is the only visual difference between pretérito tiles and their present partners (oró/ora, trabajó/trabajo) — extends DEFECTS #20/D6.
renderDebt.rule: art debt files for the design pass; it never blocks the exam and never moves a floor (R6).

patternsRef: Item kinds are matched by KIND (hear-choose / hear-act / gap-fill / verse-complete / reading / speak), the same contract as a1-u02…a1-u08. The p1-p8 pattern shapes may dangle until R9b's CONTENT-a1-pack.md §B re-authoring lands (R-5) — not a blocker for filing.

items.verse: Y ACONTECIÓ en aquellos días que salió edicto de parte de Augusto César, que toda la tierra fuese empadronada. Este empadronamiento primero fué hecho siendo Cirenio gobernador de la Siria. E iban todos para ser empadronados, cada uno á su ciudad. Y subió José de Galilea, de la ciudad de Nazaret, á Judea, á la ciudad de David, que se llama Bethlehem, por cuanto era de la casa y familia de David; Para ser empadronado con María su mujer, desposada con él, la cual estaba en cinta. Y aconteció que estando ellos allí, se cumplieron los días en que ella había de parir. Y parió á su hijo primogénito, y le envolvió en pañales, y acostóle en un pesebre, porque no había lugar para ellos en el mesón.
